stories.title: North Wales Police warn of rise in arson incidents across north Flintshire
stories.summary: North Wales Police say they are dealing with a rise in arson incidents across north Flintshire. Officers say the majority of recent fires have involved children and teenagers. stories.title: Smoking-related illness costs Betsi Cadwaladr health board nearly £300m a year, report shows
stories.summary: Smoking is costing Wales an estimated £1.56 billion a year, according to a new Public Health Wales report. stories.title: New councillors elected to Flintshire County Council in two by-elections
stories.summary: New councillors have been elected in both of Flintshire’s by-elections, held on Thursday in Connah’s Quay Central and Argoed and New Brighton. Dave Vernon has been elected in Connah’s Quay Central for Reform UK, according to the official declaration of result.
